value.name: Clean Power Alliance (CPA) - 100% Green Power (default)
value.notes: Confirmed via a directly-fetched California Community Choice Association (CalCCA) press release (October 24, 2022): Redondo Beach was named among 'Seven cities and one county within Clean Power Alliance's (CPA) service territory' that 'chosen 100% Green Power as their default energy option' beginning October 2022. Customers may choose another CPA option or opt out at any time.

county.notes: Redondo Beach is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value.name: Completed permit application via the Citizen Portal
Standard electrical plan (systems <=10 kW) or custom plan with inverter specs, one-line diagram, grounding/bonding details, equipment cut sheets, and code labeling
Roof plan showing panel layout, fire safety access pathways, and PV system classification
Structural criteria documentation (expedited form for qualifying systems; engineered drawings/calculations by a California-licensed engineer for non-qualifying systems)

value: Schedule on-site inspections through the CTS portal
Inspector verifies compliance with code and approved plans; applicant must demonstrate conformance with all technical requirements in the field
Inspections scheduled before 3:00pm are typically inspected the next business day

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited permitting (one- and two-family dwellings, systems 10 kW or smaller)
other_conditions: All solar applications must be submitted via the CTS Portal
